title: Build a Minimal Document
prompt:
Write the smallest complete HTML page: a doctype, an `html` element with `lang`, a `head` containing the charset meta, and a `body` with one paragraph saying hello. Rules: - Include the doctype declaration. - The `html` tag declares `lang="en"`. - The `head` contains ``. - The `body` contains one `

`.

tests.name: starts with a doctype
tests.hint: The very first line of the file must be <!DOCTYPE html>.

tests.name: has an html element with lang
tests.hint: Write <html lang="en"> as the root element.

tests.name: head declares the charset
body contains a paragraph
